column1: # Retrieval quality for the academy corpus.
# `question<TAB>expected_id`. The expected id is the node a person asking that
# question should be shown FIRST — written from the content, before running the
# search, which is the only order that makes the number mean anything.
# Run it:  metis retrieval-bench --questions docs/academy/retrieval-questions.tsv
# This file is the worked example. For a real corpus, write your own: the value
# is entirely in somebody who knows the material deciding the right answers in
# advance.

what if two facts arrive at different times
